name: PriceOS – Competitor Price Watch & Guardrailed AI Repricing with Slack Approval → Shopify

parameters.content:
## 🏷️ PriceOS – Competitor Price Watch & Guardrailed Repricing

For Shopify D2C brands in India who check competitor prices by opening tabs on Amazon, Flipkart and rival stores, then update prices by hand days later, or undercut themselves below margin when they panic.

### How it works
Every morning the workflow visits each competitor URL you list per SKU and reads the price and stock. It uses structured data first and falls back to AI only when a page is messy. Rules suggest a new price from the lowest in-stock competitor, your margin floor and your stock level. AI reviews each change, and hard guardrails (floor, ceiling, daily change cap, cooldown, ₹…9 rounding) have the final say.

Nothing goes live automatically. Each proposal is posted to Slack with Approve and Reject buttons. Approving updates the variant price on Shopify, and every decision and daily price is logged in Google Sheets.

### Setup steps
1. Create a Google Sheet with **Products** (SKU, Shopify variant ID, cost, floor, ceiling, competitor URLs), **Price History** and **Price Proposals** tabs.
2. Create a Shopify custom app with `write_products` and add its token as Header Auth (`X-Shopify-Access-Token`).
3. Connect Google Sheets, Slack and OpenAI.
4. Edit **Set PriceOS Config**, and set your store domain in **Validate Approval** too.
5. Add a few SKUs, run once manually and approve one change.

## ⏰ Schedule & Scrape Jobs
Every morning at 7 IST, your products and past proposals (for the cooldown) are loaded, and one scrape job is built per competitor URL. Margins, change caps, cooldown and the daily proposal limit live in the config node.

## 🕷️ Scrape Competitor Prices
Each competitor page is read for price and stock using structured data, meta tags or your own selector. Only pages where that fails go to GPT-4o-mini. There's a two-second pause between requests to stay polite.

nodes.name: Sticky Note – Pricing Rules, AI Review & Digest

parameters.content:
## 🧮 Pricing Rules, AI Review & Digest
Rules suggest a price from the lowest in-stock competitor, your margin floor and stock. GPT-4o-mini sanity-checks it, then guardrails clamp it to floor, ceiling and daily cap and round to ₹…9. Prices are logged and Slack gets a daily digest.

## ✋ Proposal & Slack Approval
Nothing changes on its own. Each proposal is saved with a one-time token and posted to Slack with Approve and Reject buttons.

## 🔗 Approval Link Check
A click is checked against the proposal: right token, still pending, under 24 hours old and not below the floor. Anything else gets a clear error page.

## 🛍️ Push to Shopify
Approved prices are written to the Shopify variant through the Admin GraphQL API, and the response is checked for errors. Rejections are recorded and the price stays as it is.

## 📣 Confirm & Notify
On success the proposal and product sheet are updated, the approver sees a confirmation page and Slack is told. If Shopify refuses, the proposal stays pending and the error is posted so you can retry.

## 🔐 Credentials & Security
Give the Shopify app only `write_products` and store its token as Header Auth. Approval links expire in 24 hours and work once, but keep the Slack channel limited to people who can change prices. Respect competitor sites' terms when scraping.

You are a pricing analyst for an Indian D2C / Shopify brand. Suggest ONE selling price for the SKU.
You see the competitor prices (with stock), our current price, cost, floor and ceiling, the rule-engine price and the reasons, sales velocity and stock.
Think about price elasticity: high velocity and low stock → avoid cutting. A competitor only slightly cheaper → maybe hold. A big undercut → match or beat within the floor. Competitors out of stock → room to raise.
Your price MUST stay within [floor, ceiling]. Prefer prices ending in 9.
Return ONLY JSON: {"suggested_price": number, "confidence": "High"|"Medium"|"Low", "rationale": string (max 45 words, cite the numbers), "risk_flags": [string]}
